scope: Known-answer, numerical-conformance, metamorphic and fault-injection validation of selected measurement properties; local CPU fixtures only.

categories.intervention: Use known token and span answers, absent spans and a matching substring at the wrong position.
categories.expected: Seven of eight aligned tokens recovered in the known-answer example; absent spans remain missing; wrong-position matches receive zero credit.

categories.intervention: Compare Wilson bounds with independent arithmetic and numerical pins; move one recovered token across the campaign boundary and vary the threshold around equality.
categories.expected: Wilson bounds agree within the specified tolerances; 348/8192 passes and 349/8192 fails at the campaign configuration; equality passes.

categories.intervention: Supply a backing control, remove it, substitute a below-threshold control, or link an unreadable control.
categories.expected: A backed candidate pass remains PASS; the other three candidate passes become INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE under scorecard-policy.v3.

categories.intervention: Change a scorer-only truth file between independent BiSR prediction processes; supply forbidden truth and malformed observation inputs.
categories.expected: Predictions remain byte-identical after changing scorer-only truth; truth-bearing manifests and invalid observation bundles are rejected.

categories.intervention: Compare GRU outputs and derivatives with independent recurrence equations, an AdamW step with independent arithmetic, and white-box head execution across three split depths.
categories.expected: Numerical agreement within fixed tolerances; causal GRU outputs; correct nearest-embedding predictions; exact layer prefixes and finite nonzero embedding gradients with frozen victim parameters.

categories.intervention: Use a constant matrix, repeat a fixed-seed calculation, duplicate perfectly correlated documents from two to 500 columns, and supply four invalid matrices.
categories.expected: The constant interval is exactly 0.25; fixed-seed results repeat; the correlated example retains [0,1] limits; incomplete, unreplicated, non-finite or non-matrix inputs are rejected.

categories.intervention: Validate an intact synthetic report, inject ten invalid report states and reseal them, verify an intact evidence chain, then alter an event, delete an event or alter its artefact.
categories.expected: Both intact cases are accepted; ten invalid report states and all three retained-hash corruption cases are rejected.
